reviews.text:
I would have never thought i would ever post a glowingly positive review for a roofing company; However, when one encounters a contractor who goes beyond the norm and takes personal pride of ownership with the work their crew performs, it is absolutely compelling to share our experience.
If you have had roofers come knock on your doors and you feel they are all the same, with not-so-great work ethics, then we too were in that same boat until we engaged Frog Roofing. From the first interaction, we felt there was something positively different.

The principals/owners at Frog Roofing actually take personal accountability to the point of ensuring that the team does a thorough job and they hold themselves to a high standard.

In a nutshell, Honesty, Transparency, Trustworthiness and Customer Satisfaction is their brand. They seem to genuinely care about their clients and go all out for them. There were no sales tactics, ever. Extremely good work ethics, and high quality of workmanship.
No shortcuts, despite the glaring summer heat of Dallas. They even cared to inspect the decking and repaired it to ensure that no rot sets in. Shows the attention to details they devote to every project.
While most roofers cut corners to maximize margins, Frog Roofing goes the extra mile so they can stand by their brand of workmanship. And they do not nickel-and-dime you. A contracted price that's based on their experience doing this for hundreds of homes, one roof at a time.

They kept us completely in the loop and communicated throughout the process. Just imagine that you are not trying to track down a contractor after you sign the papers!
Everything is backed by photo evidence. I doubt any roofer works with this much transparency in the DFW area.

Yes, engage them and be confident of a good product delivered on time within a defined budget.

Thanks, Frog Roofing, for a job well done!
